vendor/excalidraw.js and vendor/excalidraw.css are GENERATED.
Do not edit them; run node whiteboard/vendor.mjs.

This is the Whiteboard app's own bundle (same engine as the Excalidraw app).

upstream: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw
npm:      @excalidraw/excalidraw@0.18.1
react:    18.3.1
entry:    gifos-facade.js (written by vendor.mjs), IIFE, global ExcalidrawLib
          exposing { React, createRoot, Excalidraw, MainMenu, WelcomeScreen, Footer, Sidebar, serializeAsJSON, loadFromBlob, exportToBlob, exportToCanvas, exportToSvg, restoreElements, restoreAppState, reconcileElements, convertToExcalidrawElements, CaptureUpdateAction, getSceneVersion, hashElementsVersion, getNonDeletedElements, viewportCoordsToSceneCoords, sceneCoordsToViewportCoords, getCommonBounds, FONT_FAMILY, isInvisiblySmallElement }
fonts:    Latin faces inlined as data: URLs from dist/prod/fonts.
          Xiaolai (CJK, ~12 MB) is omitted; CJK falls back to the system font.

Firebase / live-collab is NOT in this package and is never called.
The public library CDN (libraries.excalidraw.com) is not fetched.
Licences ride beside the bundle and inside the GIF:
COPYING-excalidraw.txt, COPYING-react.txt.
